about: The 90-second spine. Durations, captions and camera keys live here so pacing can be tuned without touching code. A shot's camera starts where the previous shot ended. Each key gives a position inside its shot (at: 0 = start, 1 = end), the realm whose coordinates it uses, and the camera position and look-at target in that realm's units. A realm change is written as two keys with the same at: the exit pose in the old realm, then the entry pose in the new one. Module 1 covers each realm change with a short fade; portals replace the fades in Module 2. Every caption cites ledger claims, and ledger-lint checks that.

shots.label: Bolt becomes grid
shots.move: Crane up to overhead; the bolt fades, then the power line lights
shots.caption: Lightning is electricity untamed. The grid is the tamed kind.

shots.label: Grid ride
shots.move: Swoop down and track an amber pulse from the station along the line
shots.caption: Generated far away, carried here at high voltage.

shots.label: Campus doors
shots.move: Descend to the doors, through them into the hall
shots.caption: A datacenter is a building designed around power and heat.

shots.label: Hall aisle
shots.move: Dolly down the aisle, turn to face one rack
shots.caption: Thousands of servers. Nearly all their power ends up as heat.

shots.label: Into the rack
shots.move: Push into the rack, arrive above a server tray
shots.caption: Inside: accelerators built to multiply and add numbers.

shots.label: Package
shots.move: Push onto the package, arc over it as memory stacks rise
shots.caption: Memory is stacked right beside the processor, so data travels less.

shots.label: Die dive
shots.move: Top-down dive onto the array of compute units
shots.caption: Many compute units, working in parallel.

shots.label: Handoff
shots.move: Dive onto one unit, settle face-on as the tile fills with values
shots.caption: Zoom in far enough, and the work is arithmetic.

shots.label: Message to tokens
shots.move: Pull back to reveal the message; it splits into tokens
shots.caption: Your message arrives as text. First, it's cut into tokens.

shots.label: Embeddings
shots.move: Lateral glide as a column rises from each token
shots.caption: Each token becomes a long list of numbers.

shots.label: Attention
shots.move: Orbit 60 degrees around the row as arcs draw back to earlier tokens
shots.caption: Attention: each token looks back, never ahead.

shots.label: Layers
shots.move: Rise vertically through the stacked layers
shots.caption: The same structure repeats, layer after layer, with new weights.

shots.label: Logits
shots.move: Clear the top of the stack as score bars erupt
shots.caption: Out comes a score for every possible next token.

shots.label: Softmax
shots.move: Drift in as the bars melt into probabilities
shots.caption: Softmax turns scores into probabilities.

shots.label: Sample
shots.move: Push in as a weighted wheel spins and stops
shots.caption: One is chosen. Just one.

shots.label: Return trip
shots.move: The token rockets back up through every realm, time sped up
shots.caption: Then the model runs again for each new token.

shots.label: Reply
shots.move: Words type into the bubble; pull back to the city and the storm
shots.caption: One message. Every token, one trip through the machine.
